subject: mRNA-1273 Drug Substance Batch BN-22900-522
statement: Manufacturing site is Moderna, Inc. — Norwood, MA Facility
supporting_quote: Manufacturing Site: Moderna, Inc. — Norwood, MA Facility

subject: mRNA-1273 Drug Substance manufacturing
statement: Manufacturing process consists of six sequential steps: mRNA Synthesis by T7 RNA Polymerase IVT at 37.6°C, mRNA Purification by Tangential Flow Filtration at ≤5°C, LNP Formulation by Microfluidic Mixing at 44 mL/min flow rate, Diafiltration with Buffer Exchange to PBS at ≤5°C, Sterile Filtration through 0.22 µm filter at ambient temperature, and Fill-Finish with vial filling of 0.5 mL in Aseptic ISO 5 conditions.
supporting_quote: Step 1: mRNA Synthesis, T7 RNA Polymerase IVT, 37.6°C, PASS; Step 2: mRNA Purification, Tangential Flow Filtration, ≤5°C, PASS; Step 3: LNP Formulation, Microfluidic Mixing, Flow rate: 44 mL/min, PASS; Step 4: Diafiltration, Buffer Exchange to PBS, ≤5°C, PASS; Step 5: Sterile Filtration, 0.22 µm filter, Ambient, PASS; Step 6: Fill-Finish, Vial filling (0.5 mL), Aseptic ISO 5, PASS
